skill.name: image-outpainting
skill.description: Extend still images beyond their original frame with RunComfy CLI outpainting routes. The skill selects Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro, or brand edit endpoints for the requested canvas change.
skill.summary: Use RunComfy CLI models to uncrop images, change aspect ratios, and add matching canvas around existing stills.
skill.author: doany-ai

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, documentation links, and explicit token-storage documentation. The skill does intentionally run the RunComfy CLI and send prompts or image URLs to RunComfy, which is disclosed and scoped. No evidence found of prompt injection instructions, covert secret exfiltration, or hidden host reconnaissance.

remediation.issue: Shell JSON arguments may be fragile for prompts containing quotes.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend validated JSON generation, careful shell escaping, or a temporary input file before invoking runcomfy.

remediation.issue: Third-party processing is required for the core workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Keep a clear notice that image URLs and prompts are sent to RunComfy before commands run.

remediation.issue: The CLI persists an authentication token after login.
remediation.suggestion: Document token revocation or removal and prefer RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for CI or container workflows.

content.value_statement: Cropped images often do not fit banners, reels, or catalog layouts. This skill routes outpainting requests through RunComfy models and keeps the original subject preserved.
actual_capabilities: Routes outpainting prompts to RunComfy CLI image edit endpoints.
Chooses between Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro, and brand edit endpoints.
Provides examples for square-to-wide changes and portrait uncropping.
Explains prompt wording that preserves the original visible content.
Recommends ComfyUI workflows when CLI endpoints are not precise enough.
Documents exit codes, authentication, token storage, and endpoint boundaries.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a signed-in RunComfy account.
Sends prompts and image URLs to RunComfy services for processing.
Cannot run ComfyUI workflows through the CLI route described here.
Does not handle mask-driven inpainting or video outpainting.

use_cases.title: Create campaign banners
use_cases.description: Extend a square image into a wide hero frame while preserving the subject and lighting.

use_cases.title: Reframe product images
use_cases.description: Add matching space around a product photo so it fits marketplace or catalog layouts.

use_cases.title: Restore cropped archive photos
use_cases.description: Uncrop a historical or reference image with style guidance from related source material.

prompt_templates.title: Extend a square image
prompt_templates.prompt: Outpaint this square image to 16:9. Extend both sides with matching background, lighting, and camera distance. Keep the original subject unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Uncrop a portrait
prompt_templates.scenario: Reveal more of a cropped subject
prompt_templates.prompt: Extend this portrait downward to show more upper body and arms. Match the clothing, lighting, and background. Preserve the face exactly.

prompt_templates.title: Match a reference style
prompt_templates.scenario: Use a second image for surrounding style
prompt_templates.prompt: Outpaint the main image into a wider layout. Use the reference image only for surrounding style, texture, color, and lighting cues.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a staged extension
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a two-pass outpainting plan for this image. Extend only 40 percent per pass, then review seams before the second pass.

output_examples.input: A square portrait needs a wide website banner version.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects a RunComfy edit route, extends the sides, and returns a saved wide image with the subject centered.

output_examples.input: A cropped product photo needs more counter space around it.
output_examples.output: The assistant builds an outpainting prompt that matches surface texture, shadows, and lighting while keeping the product unchanged.

output_examples.input: A restored photo needs a taller frame without changing the visible face.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends a preservation-focused route and asks for reference material if period style is important.

best_practices: Provide a direct image URL and state the target aspect ratio.
Describe which sides should extend and what should continue there.
Add preservation language for faces, products, logos, and key objects.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for video canvas extension.
Do not send image URLs that the user did not explicitly provide.
Do not request precise internal mask edits through this outpainting route.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps an agent outpaint still images through RunComfy CLI image edit models.

faq.question: Does it require a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The RunComfy CLI must be installed and authenticated before commands can run.

faq.question: Can it change a square image into a banner?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes guidance for square-to-wide and portrait-to-landscape outpainting.

faq.question: Can it match another image style?
faq.answer: Yes. It can route reference-style requests to models that support multiple references.

faq.question: Does it keep the original image unchanged?
faq.answer: It prompts for preservation, but generative edits can still alter details. Review results before final use.

faq.question: Where are results saved?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI downloads generated results into the output directory selected for the command.
